sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
'''Kreutalk: DeFoe's Titan''' is one of the best heroes around for Missions that involve objects. If you're trying to complete the expert Mission [[TCG:SAS-155|Go to the Hidden Cave]], Kreutalk is a great choice! Once it picks up a [[TCG:SAS-165|Speedboat]] in zone 1, it'll become unblockable, and its power will let it move straight to zone 4, where it can enter the hidden cave a round later! With 5 ATK/4 DEF, it's going to be hard for your opponent to do anything to stop this speedy [[Swara-Titan]].
